method: Arithmetic mean of paired MiniLM cosine against public-message English references; decoder 'unknown' answers and structural glosses are embedded as ordinary text. Task status, discarded messages, and unscorable references are excluded. Not percent accuracy.
text_normalization: Parse the original numbered translation section with the recorded core parser; remove message IDs, speaker/confidence prefixes and normalize whitespace. For a validated Msg/Agent/Meaning/Confidence Markdown table, retain the meaning cell literally and preserve the full original row for audit. Do not replace unknown declarations, remove their parenthetical text, rewrite glosses, expand aliases, infer missing entries, or use private intended meanings.

metric_definition.cosine: Arithmetic mean of paired MiniLM cosine against public-message English references; decoder 'unknown' answers and structural glosses are embedded as ordinary text. Task status, discarded messages, and unscorable references are excluded. Not percent accuracy.
metric_definition.unknown_detection: Lexical flags are descriptive only; do not alter text or score inclusion.
metric_definition.missing: Historical cells must have complete alignment. Fresh follow-ups may retain missing entries as unscored with coverage shown; no invented text.
metric_definition.historical_classifications: Retained for audit only; do not alter text or score inclusion.
